fact: The Sistema de Gestao Autarquico (e-SISTAFE Autarquico), covering municipal revenue capture among its components, was launched on 21 February 2020 by CEDSIF with a pilot in 3 municipalities (Maputo, Matola, Boane), to expand to at least 10 more that year.
title: Lançado o Sistema de Gestão Autárquico (SGA), na componente e-SISTAFE Autárquico
